subject: Access to data and variables in a running shiny app from Rstudio

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Access to data and variables in a running shiny app from Rstudio
parts:
I have been working on a Shiny app of-and-on for a while now that will allow users to run various analyses and manipulate data locally on their computer. Of course, a GUI may not be as flexible as actual code written by a user. Using the ShinyAce package I added a simple code editor to the app where the user can write code that will access the data and variable values in the running Shiny app (see R > Code at http://vnijs.rady.ucsd.edu:3838/marketing/ or install the app from https://github.com/mostly-harmless/radiant). I also added a feature that will allow the user to 'paste' the code from an analyses they did using the Shiny gui into a rmarkdown editor. It works ok, but only when run locally of course.

However this feels a bit like reinventing the wheel as I try to replicate a few of the excellent features in Rstudio. 

So here is my question: Is it feasible to add a feature to Rstudio that will allow access to reactive values etc. in a running Shiny app? You would start the Shiny app from Rstudio and then could write functions, use the console, etc. to access the data you loaded through the shiny app or get the output generate by using the gui? Even better would be if you could also directly 'paste' commands generated by the gui into an rmarkdown document open in Rstudio but I assume that would be more difficult to implement.

I also posted this question here. If there is a better place to post this please let me know.

Vincent

messages.subject: Re: Access to data and variables in a running shiny app from Rstudio
parts:
I don't get the feeling that accessing a Shiny app from R-studio is going to happen any time soon. So in the mean time ... the version of shinyAce on github allows you to select and submit lines of code and submit them in the Shiny environment (try https://github.com/mostly-harmless/radiant).

I am wondering if there is a possibility to link a key-board shortcut to an action button? e.g., In the app you can select a code block and then hit the 'update' action button to have the evaluated. Could you have, for example, CMD-Enter (or CTRL-Enter) increment an action button?
